request.style: English, female solo voice with soft choir, harp, strings, acoustic guitar, ambient pads, reverent and dramatic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
This happened in the days of Ahasuerus
Ruling over a hundred and twenty-seven provinces
Seated on his royal throne in Susa
In the third year of his reign he gave a feast

[Verse]
A hundred and eighty days of wealth displayed
Splendid glory of his greatness seen
Then seven days in the garden court
For all the people in the citadel

[Pre-Chorus]
Queen Vashti gave a banquet for the women
In the royal palace of the king
On the seventh day his heart was merry
With wine he commanded the eunuchs

[Chorus]
Bring Queen Vashti wearing her royal crown
To display her beauty to the peoples
She was lovely to look at they said
But she refused to come at the command

[Verse]
The king became furious in his heart
His anger burned within him deep
He consulted the wise men who knew the law
To ask what should be done with her

[Chorus]
Bring Queen Vashti wearing her royal crown
To display her beauty to the peoples
She was lovely to look at they said
But she refused to come at the command

[Bridge]
Memucan answered before the king
She has wronged all the officials
The women will despise their husbands
If she does not obey the decree

[Outro]
Let the royal position go to another
To a woman who is better than she
